RrsTAmsLcan 1922-800 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT april AGREEMENT dated as of Mrehr _, 2008, between D.A.B. Group LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address of 85 West Hawthorne Avenue, Valley Stream, New York 11580 (*"Developer"), and 81-83 Rivington Corp., a New York corporation having an address of 81 Rivington Street, New York, New York 10002 ("Owner"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of NewYork, known as and by the street address 81 Rivington Street and on the tax map as Block 415, Lot 63 (as more particularly described on Exhibit “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof, hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owner's Premises"); WHEREAS,Developeris the owner of thefee titleto certainparcels of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, as follows: (i) known as and by the street address 79 Rivington Street, New York, New York and on the tax map as Block 415, Lot 62 (as more particularly described on Exhibit “B" attached hereto and made a part hereof, hereinafter referred to as “Lot B"); (i) known as and by the street address 77 Rivington Street, New York, New York and on the tax map as Block 415, Lot 61 (as more particularly described on Exhibit "C"” attached hereto and made a part hereof, hereinafter referred to as "Lot C"); (i) known as and by the street address 141 Orchard Street, New York, NewYork and on the tax map as Block 415,Lot66(as more particularly described onExhibit "D" attached hereto and made a part hereof, hereinafter referred to as “Lot D"); and (iv) known as and by the street address 139 Orchard Street, New York, New York and on the tax map as Block 415, Lot 67 (as more particularly described on Exhibit “E” attached hereto and made a part hereof, hereinafter referred to as “Lot E") (all of the foregoing said parcels of land hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Developer's Land";all existing buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto built on Developer's Land, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “Developer's Building"; and the Developer's Land and Developer's Building, together with Developer's New Building, 'as herein defined, hereinafter collectively referred to as the"Developer's Premises"); WHEREAS, Owner's Land and Lot B are contiguous and, pursuant to the Declaration hereinafter referred to, constitute a single “zoning lot” under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution(ashereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Lot B, Lot C and Lot D are contiguous and Lot D and Lot E are contiguous, and Developer has combined,or intends to combine,Lot B,Lot C,Lot Dand Lot E to constitute a single “zoning lot” under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish the improvements onLot D and/or the improvements on Lot E and to construct a new building on Lot D and/or Lot E (herein called the "Developer'sNewBuilding"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer's New Building will contain more floor area than now is available for use on Lot D and Lot E pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to use the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Land and the Developer's Land into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available the Excess Zoning Rights (hereinafter defined) for use in connection with the construction and maintenance of Developer's New Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Zoning Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS,Owner iswilling:(a)toreduce thenumber of squarefeet of floor area that Owner may include and maintain in Owner's Building, and (b) to restrict construction of additional floor area on Owner's Building that otherwise might be permitted in order to make the Excess ZoningRights available toDeveloper; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") from Owner's Land, Lot B, and such other parcels as may beincluded therein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and other good and valuable hereby agree as follows: 1.  The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter set forth: (a) “Zoning Resolution"shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. (b)“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the NewYork City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of New York. (c)“Reserved Development Rights" shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Premises at any time less 3,502.08 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights. (d)“Excess Zoning Rights" shall mean 3,502.08 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner's Premises. 2 NY126496696.5/57363-000001
